plans.title: System Architecture MVP — v2 Revisions
plans.purpose: Update system_architecture_MVP.drawio to address review findings: consent check, session lifecycle, split data stores, pseudonymized audit, data lifecycle layer

steps.content: Add consent check (diamond) after auth — orange node, 403 path on No
steps.outcome: consent node added with consent_fail path

steps.content: Split PostgreSQL into messages_table (session_id keyed, 90-day TTL) + user_context_table (user_id keyed: life_context + conversation_summary)
Add load_context step after POST /chat — reads life_context + conversation_summary from user_context_table
steps.outcome: load_context node added between postchat and fetch_db

steps.content: Update threshold diamond label to 'compression only' — compression worker writes only conversation_summary to user_context_table
steps.outcome: Label updated, worker relabeled Compression Worker

steps.content: Add Session-End Hook + Session-End Worker — always runs on session close, writes both life_context + conversation_summary to user_context_table
Update audit table — pseudonymized only (user_id, action, ts), partitioned by user_id, tombstone support
Add data lifecycle layer — Retention Policy Worker (auto-delete messages 90d) + DELETE /user/{id}/data erasure endpoint
Add legend entries for Compliance (orange) and Data Lifecycle (green)

plans.title: FastAPI Chat Endpoint — Gemini LLM with Followup Question
plans.purpose: Build a POST /chat endpoint that takes user text, sends it to Gemini, and returns a response with a followup question
learnings: gemini-1.5-flash is deprecated; use gemini-2.0-flash with google-genai SDK

steps.content: Fill requirements.txt with fastapi, uvicorn, google-generativeai, pydantic-settings, python-dotenv
steps.implementation_outline: Add pinned or unpinned deps for the Gemini SDK and FastAPI stack
steps.verification: File exists and contains all 5 deps — pip install -r requirements.txt should succeed
steps.outcome: requirements.txt written with fastapi, uvicorn[standard], google-generativeai, pydantic-settings, python-dotenv

steps.content: Define config.py: load GEMINI_API_KEY from .env via pydantic-settings
steps.implementation_outline: BaseSettings class with GEMINI_API_KEY; single settings singleton
steps.verification: from app.config import settings; assert settings.GEMINI_API_KEY != ""
steps.outcome: config.py written with BaseSettings loading GEMINI_API_KEY from .env

steps.content: Define schemas.py: ChatRequest (user_message: str) and ChatResponse (reply: str, followup_question: str)
steps.verification: from app.schemas import ChatRequest, ChatResponse; ChatResponse(reply="hi", followup_question="what?")
steps.outcome: schemas.py written with ChatRequest and ChatResponse Pydantic models

steps.content: Write prompts.py: system prompt that instructs Gemini to always end with one followup question
steps.verification: from app.services.prompts import SYSTEM_PROMPT; assert "followup_question" in SYSTEM_PROMPT
steps.outcome: prompts.py written with SYSTEM_PROMPT instructing Gemini to return raw JSON only

steps.content: Write llm.py: async function call_gemini(user_message) -> ChatResponse using google-generativeai SDK
steps.implementation_outline: Configure genai with API key, call model.generate_content, parse reply and followup from response text
steps.verification: Run uvicorn, POST a message, confirm ChatResponse fields are populated
steps.outcome: llm.py written with async call_gemini, code fence stripping, and JSON parsing into ChatResponse

steps.content: Write chat.py router: POST /chat accepts ChatRequest, calls call_gemini, returns ChatResponse
steps.verification: POST /api/chat with valid user_message returns 200 with reply and followup_question fields
steps.outcome: chat.py written with POST /chat route, JSONDecodeError and generic exception handling

steps.content: Register chat router in main.py and verify endpoint works with uvicorn
steps.verification: Run: uvicorn app.main:app --reload from backend/; POST http://localhost:8000/api/chat with {\"user_message\": \"hello\"} should return {\"reply\": \"...\", \"followup_question\": \"...\"}
steps.outcome: main.py updated to import chat_router and mount it at /api prefix

plans.user_plan_request: Simple FastAPI endpoint where user sends text, Gemini LLM responds with a followup question

plans.title: Session, History & Auth
plans.purpose: Add session persistence, multi-turn conversation history, and auth to the RedDust backend

steps.content: Create services/session_store.py: in-memory dict mapping session_id (UUID) to list of messages [{role, text}]
steps.implementation_outline: Module-level dict; functions: get_history(session_id), append_message(session_id, role, text), clear_session(session_id)
steps.verification: from app.services.session_store import append_message, get_history; append_message('x','user','hi'); assert get_history('x') == [{'role':'user','text':'hi'}]
steps.outcome: session_store.py created with in-memory defaultdict and get_history, append_message, clear_session functions

steps.content: Update schemas.py: ChatRequest adds optional session_id (str | None); ChatResponse adds session_id (str)
steps.implementation_outline: session_id: str | None = None on request; session_id: str on response
steps.verification: from app.schemas import ChatRequest, ChatResponse; ChatRequest(user_message='hi') — session_id defaults None; ChatResponse(reply='x', followup_question='y', session_id='abc')
steps.outcome: schemas.py updated: ChatRequest has optional session_id, ChatResponse has required session_id

steps.content: Update llm.py: call_gemini accepts session_id, loads history from session_store, builds contents list for Gemini, appends user+assistant messages after response
steps.implementation_outline: contents = [{role: user/model, parts: [text]}...] built from history + current message; store both turns after success
steps.verification: Two sequential POSTs with same session_id; second call should have context of first
steps.outcome: llm.py updated: call_gemini accepts session_id, builds contents from history, appends both turns to session_store after response

steps.content: Update chat.py: generate session_id if not provided, pass it to call_gemini, return it in ChatResponse
steps.verification: POST /api/chat without session_id returns a new session_id; POST with same session_id reuses it
steps.outcome: chat.py updated: generates uuid session_id if not provided, passes it to call_gemini, returns it in response

steps.content: Manual test: two sequential curl calls with the same session_id — second response should reference first message context
steps.implementation_outline: Send 'my name is Alex', then 'what is my name?' with same session_id

steps.content: Add JWT auth: install python-jose[cryptography], passlib[bcrypt]; create services/auth.py with create_token and verify_token
steps.implementation_outline: HS256 JWT; SECRET_KEY loaded from .env via config.py

steps.content: Add POST /auth/register and POST /auth/login endpoints with in-memory user store; login returns JWT
steps.implementation_outline: users dict {username: hashed_password}; register hashes and stores; login verifies and returns token

steps.content: Protect POST /chat with JWT: extract Bearer token, verify, attach username to request; session_id scoped per user
steps.implementation_outline: FastAPI Depends(verify_token) on the chat route

steps.content: Manual test: register → login → get token → POST /chat with Bearer token; verify auth works and history persists
steps.implementation_outline: Full curl flow end to end
